name: Keyline Icons v2.6.0 (1,833 MIT icons, 4 styles)
summary: Free icon set for shadcn/ui and any UI: 1,833 icons on a 24px grid, each in stroke, two-tone, duotone and fill, cut rounded and sharp (14,664 SVGs). v2.6.0 (2026-11-08) adds 141 icons (food, clothing, buildings). SVG files plus npm packages (React, React Native, CLI, MCP) and a Figma plugin.

access.notes: MIT: keep the copyright/permission notice when redistributing the files; no attribution needed in shipped UI per publisher.

procedure: Browse and search icons on keylineicons.com, copy or export the SVG
Or install the npm package (e.g. @keyline-icons/react) for React projects
Or download the v2.6.0 source zip from GitHub for all SVGs

stats.count: 1,833 icons x 4 styles x 2 corners = 14,664 SVGs

verdict.why: Large, consistent MIT icon set with real traction (197 stars, npm ~10k weekly per site); official release post with 66 likes/46 bookmarks. Directly usable in apps, games UI and sites.

image.alt: Grid of Keyline Icons v2.6.0 new icons in four styles on black, title '141 new free icons, 1,833 in all, MIT licensed'
